actions.name: demonic restoration
actions.desc: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.

actions.name: magic resistance
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: stench
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=mJbwhj3beOIB3Jgj]], any creature (other than a [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}) that starts its turn in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=mJbwhj3beOIB3Jgj]]-foot Emanation originating from the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}. Failure: The target has the &Reference[Poisoned apply=false] condition until the start of its next turn. Success: The target is immune to the Stench of all [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} for 1 hour.

actions.name: leap
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} jumps up to [[lookup @range.value activity=C28C43DeD8iFtZMe]] feet by [[lookup @activation.condition activity=C28C43DeD8iFtZMe]].
